description: A scene's code, the desktop apps' alone. Code is run only once its host's user has trusted it as it is (theme_trust: the sha256 of its files): changed, it isn't run till it's trusted again, and the scene is drawn as scene.json has it.

python.description: A Python file in the theme (desktop/scene.py) whose setup(scene) is called with the scene's SceneAPI as the scene starts: it may move, add and take away the scene's nodes each frame and answer picks.

shaders.description: GLSL shaders in the theme by a material's shader name (shaders/<file>.glsl): a fragment shader's body the desktop's GL scene compiles in place of its own lighting for the materials that name it.
